## Things to do

- Ruby Falls <https://www.rubyfalls.com/>
- Rock City <https://www.seerockcity.com/>
- View at the top of the incline railway (free)
- Tennessee Aquarium <https://tnaqua.org/>
- Creative Discovery Museum <https://www.cdmfun.org/>
- Walnut street bridge <https://www.walnutstreetbridge.com/>
  - Coolidge Park
  - Renaissance Park
- Nooga lights at the choo choo <https://noogalights.com/>
- Zoo at night (asian lantern festival going on currently) <https://www.chattzoo.org/events/alf-2024-2025>
- International Towing Museum <https://towingmuseum.com/>

## Places to eat

- Coffee:
  - Frothy Monkey (attached to choo choo) <https://frothymonkey.com/locations/southside-chattanooga-tn/>
  - Rembrandts Coffee House <https://bluffviewartdistrictchattanooga.com/rembrandtscoffeehouse>
  
- Food:
  - Hello Monty <https://www.hellomontyonmain.com/>
  - Tupelo Honey Cafe <https://tupelohoneycafe.com/restaurant/chattanooga/>
  - State of Confusion <https://www.soconfusion.com/>
  - Feed <https://www.feedtableandtavern.com/>
